models_evaluated: machine learning model predicting 6-month ARAT (developed on Dutch cohort)

links.outcome: Prediction error and calibration in independent external cohort versus development cohort
links.effect: MedAE 5.7 (IQR 1.9-15.1) vs 3.9 (IQR 1.1-13.0), P=0.12; calibration close to ideal above ARAT 40 but systematic underprediction at lower predicted scores.
links.quote: Overall prediction error was comparable between the validation and development cohorts (MedAE = 5.7 [IQR 1.9-15.1] vs 3.9 [IQR 1.1-13.0]; P = 0.12).

screen.reason: The study conducts an independent external validation of an existing machine learning prognostic model for stroke recovery across different countries and stroke types to assess clinical generalizability and calibration prior to deployment.
